name: Galio Sundae Patisserie
description: A sorbet-coloured pastry parlour for a single bakery: a cocoa side rail with a scalloped awning edge, a hero slider of the best-selling collections with filling tabs, line-drawn collections on a lemon band, a photo mosaic of the real ways to get an order, a price list with dot leaders by collection, best sellers on round tinted plates with tilted stickers, the real counter on a map, the journal, and a cocoa footer with the newsletter and the theme row; light by default with a dark mode.
